text.hi: किताब: पाँच वाक्यों को सही क्रम में लगाकर आज़ाद पर पैराग्राफ़ बनाओ। पाठ के क्रम में: b → d → a → c → e।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: paanch vaakyon ko sahi kram mein lagaakar Azad par paragraph banao. Paath ke kram mein: b → d → a → c → e.
text.en: The book: put the five sentences in order to make a paragraph about Azad. In the lesson's order: b → d → a → c → e.

steps.question: Which sentence comes first?
options: Chandra Shekhar was born in village Bhabra in Jhabua district.
As a revolutionary, he adopted the surname ‘Azad’.
A special award will be presented at Bhopal on Balidan Diwas.
steps.answer: Chandra Shekhar was born in village Bhabra in Jhabua district.

steps.question: Which sentence comes second?
options: For higher education he went to Sanskrit Pathshala at Varanasi.
He was deeply hurt by the Jallianwala Bagh massacre in 1919.
A special award will be presented at Bhopal on Balidan Diwas.
steps.answer: For higher education he went to Sanskrit Pathshala at Varanasi.

steps.question: Which sentence comes last?
options: A special award will be presented at Bhopal on Balidan Diwas.
Chandra Shekhar was born in village Bhabra in Jhabua district.
For higher education he went to Sanskrit Pathshala at Varanasi.
steps.answer: A special award will be presented at Bhopal on Balidan Diwas.

prompt.en: Tell the surname he took as a revolutionary.
